scope: The tool-call monitor of Secure_Agent: the gate (_execute_tool), the call budget, the model-call budget and the completion rule, over a whole session. The model, the tools and the clock are the attacker.
tick: One tick = one event of the session: a new turn, a tool call, a model call, a ticket expiry, a completion claim. A tick describes what the event does.
environment: Untrusted and unconstrained: which event comes next, which tools the plan asks for, which extra grants the verifier adds, the policy, the clock. Nothing the model says is trusted.

signals.exec_sens: a tool of the class 'sensitive read' really executed in this event
signals.exec_send: a tool of the class 'external send' really executed in this event
signals.exec_outside_plan: a tool executed that the plan of the turn did not request
signals.exec_unauthorized: a tool executed without a valid ticket, outside the grants or outside the policy (recomputed independently on real traces, true by construction in the model)
signals.llm_over_cap: a model call reached the provider although the turn had already used up its call budget
signals.completed_no_evidence: a turn was completed although its plan asked for a tool and no tool call of the turn had succeeded

requirements.title: No unauthorized execution
requirements.why: A tool runs only with a valid ticket, inside the grants and inside the policy, whatever the model asks for.

requirements.title: Least privilege
requirements.why: A verifier that adds a tool the plan never asked for must not widen what can run (privilege escalation through the verifier).

requirements.title: No send after a sensitive read
requirements.fretish: after exec_sens Monitor shall always satisfy !exec_send
requirements.why: Each tool is allowed on its own, but the chain read-then-send leaks. After a sensitive read in the session no external send executes, however the model orders its calls.

requirements.title: Model-call budget
requirements.why: A turn cannot make the system spend without limit: no model call is made once the budget of the turn is used up.

requirements.title: No completion without evidence
requirements.why: A turn whose plan needed a tool is not completed unless a tool call succeeded.
